description:
Whether a property or its neighbours have a state cleanup file, an underground storage tank, or a legal restriction on use, from Minnesota Pollution Control Agency records. Returns the true matching count, up to six example rows, and a link to the dataset's documentation.

Example invocations:
- "Is there a leaking tank at 1800 University Ave W, Saint Paul?"
- "Any open contamination files within a quarter mile of this lot?"

address.description: A street address in the seven-county Minneapolis-St. Paul metro, city after a comma. Omit for the market-wide count.

cut.description: all: every cleanup and tank file; open: still open; tanks: storage tanks; restricted: a legal restriction on the property's use. Default all.

within_ft.description: Radius in feet around `address`. Default 5280 (one mile), capped at 26400.

name: contamination_check
title: Contamination Check
